WELCOME.message:
🖨️ *Welcome to Citizen Print!*

How can I help you today?

📦 Type *Order* to place an order
🛍️ Or just tell me what you need!
   _Example: 'I need 500 visiting cards'_
🕒 Type *Hours* to know our timings
📋 Type *Catalog* to see all products

AWAITING_PRODUCT.message:

Please tell me *what product* you need and *how many*.

_Example: 500 visiting cards, 200 flyers, 1000 stickers_
